title: SAT-RL: Training Language Models for Logical Reasoning with Symbolic Solvers
abstract: arXiv:2610.14402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have achieved strong performance in mathematical and logical reasoning, yet they still suffer from the curse of complexity and struggle as problem difficulty increases with the number of constraint interactions and the size of the search space. In contrast, satisfiability solvers such as Z3 provide scalable and verifiable reasoning through constraint solving under formal theories, but lack the flexibility to interpret natural-language problem descriptions. In this work, we propose SAT-RL, a reinforcement-learning (RL) framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution. SAT-RL leverages synthetic data generation with verifiable solutions, supervised warm-up on solver-augmented traces, and solver-grounded reinforcement learning with tool-aware rewards. Experiments show that SAT-RL substantially improves symbolic reasoning with tools on both in-domain and out-of-domain

translated_title: SAT-RL：利用符号求解器训练语言模型进行逻辑推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）在数学和逻辑推理方面已经取得了强劲的表现，但仍然受困于复杂性诅咒，随着约束交互数量和搜索空间规模的增加、问题难度上升时表现挣扎。相比之下，以Z3为代表的可满足性求解器通过在形式理论下的约束求解提供了可扩展且可验证的推理能力，但缺乏解读自然语言问题描述的灵活性。在本工作中，我们提出了SAT-RL，这是一个强化学习（RL）框架，通过多轮工具执行来训练大语言模型与符号求解器进行交互。SAT-RL利用了带有可验证解的合成数据生成、基于求解器增强轨迹的监督预热训练，以及带有工具感知奖励、以求解器结果为依据的强化学习。实验表明，SAT-RL在域内和域外基准上都显著提升了模型借助工具进行符号推理的能力。
tldr: 该论文提出SAT-RL强化学习框架，通过多轮工具执行、可验证解的合成数据和基于求解器的工具感知奖励，训练大语言模型与符号求解器协作，从而显著提升其在域内和域外任务上的逻辑推理能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SAT-RL, a reinforcement learning framework that trains LLMs to interact with symbolic solvers through multi-turn tool execution, leveraging synthetic data with verifiable solutions and solver-grounded tool-aware rewards to substantially improve logical reasoning on both in-domain and out-of-domain tasks.
